purpose: Repeatable field-test order for collecting the minimum evidence needed by Phase161 while keeping invasive actions and personal identifiers out of the default workflow.

stages.title_ja: 端末・回線・ソフトウェア条件を固定
recommended: Phase159 software snapshot key when available
Android build/baseband or iPhone modem firmware/carrier settings version when visible
notes: On iPhone, Settings > General > About exposes software version, Modem Firmware and carrier information; carrier settings version is visible by the Carrier field.
Do not retain unredacted IMEI/EID/serial/subscriber identifiers.

stages.title_ja: SIM/eSIM認識とeSIMライフサイクル
rules: For pSIM-only tests, eSIM-specific observations may remain not_applicable/not_tested.
Profile installation/enablement is not promoted to network/service success.
Signal bars or 4G/5G icons are not a substitute for explicit registration evidence when deep evidence is required.

stages.title_ja: データ回線・APN/DNN・実通信
test_order: Confirm intended data SIM/line on dual-SIM devices.
Check official APN/DNN only when the platform/carrier exposes or requires it.
Perform a simple real data test separately from internal-state observations.
stages.rule: A successful web/data test does not backfill APN/session/IP/DNS/VALIDATED states.

test_order: Capture policy/provisioning/registration only when exact evidence is available.
Test outgoing and incoming voice separately.
Test SMS send and receive separately.
Record VoLTE/VoNR/Wi-Fi Calling bearer only when actually observed.
stages.rule: Successful voice does not identify its bearer; generic SMS success does not prove SMS over IMS.

deep_capture: On supported/authorized Android environments, PhysicalChannelConfig can provide band, network type, primary/secondary status and channel bandwidth.
Treat LTE+/5G+/NR Advanced as display hints only.

stages.title_ja: 証拠・プライバシー・診断投入
required: Attach evidence refs to observed results.
Project explicit observation_records into Phase161 input.
Keep untested items untested/unknown instead of filling them.
